sections.Profile:
Now is a 1971 electro-mechanical pinball machine produced by D. Gottlieb & Co., designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison. The game features a psychedelic theme, typical of its era, and offers four-player gameplay.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1971
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Trippy, Drugs, Original Theme, 1970s
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Gordon Morison
- Design: Ed Krynski
